nodes.label: Dynamic Tool Registry (toolsRegistry)
nodes.rationale: Hardcoding links in Sidebar.tsx scatters feature flags and visibility rules across layout files. A centralized registry in src/akira-os/tools/registry.ts holds paths, categories, ready states and visibility restrictions; the sidebar queries it. Rejected scanning the TanStack route tree because route paths carry no category or developer-mode flag. Cost: new modules must be registered in both the route tree and the registry. Status: Accepted.

edges.source_location: Decision (the sidebar, owned by the Shell, queries the registry)
